description: Stable identifier: buyer-target-year, with a month qualifier where one buyer has several deals with one target in a year.
Date the deal was first made public (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM where only the month is known).
coding_rule: Use the company announcement or filing date. If the deal was first reported before any announcement, use the date of the first substantiated report naming both parties; date_basis says which applies.

description: Precision of announce_date.
Buyer, as commonly named.
Country of the buyer’s headquarters.
coding_rule: From an SEC issuer record or the buyer’s own filings where available. "not disclosed" = no eligible source states the value. It does not mean none.

description: Startup or lab, as commonly named.
Country where the target operates (headquarters or main operations).
coding_rule: "not disclosed" = no eligible source states the value. It does not mean none.

description: What the target does, in the sources’ words.
Structure of the transaction.
coding_rule: LICENCE_AND_HIRE: technology licence plus hiring of founders or staff. TEAM_ONLY_HIRE: founders or staff hired, no licence disclosed. MINORITY_STAKE_CONTROL: minority stake with a board seat, veto, consultation or similar right. COMPUTE_FOR_EQUITY: equity paid for wholly or partly in compute or cloud credits, or tied to a compute commitment. OTHER_HYBRID: investment plus a stated commercial tie.

description: Whether the deal includes a licence of the target’s technology.
coding_rule: "not disclosed" = no eligible source states the value. It does not mean none.

description: Whether that licence is exclusive.
coding_rule: yes or no only where a source states it. "not disclosed" = no eligible source states the value. It does not mean none.

description: Buyer’s shareholding after the deal, with its basis.
coding_rule: As stated; never derived from amounts. "not disclosed" = no eligible source states the value. It does not mean none.

description: Disclosed consideration in US dollars.
coding_rule: Only an amount stated by a source; never estimated or converted from other figures. "not disclosed" = no eligible source states the value. It does not mean none.

description: What disclosed_value_usd covers.
How the value is stated (for example point, ceiling, approximate, conflicting estimates).
Grade of the best source for the value.
Founders who joined the buyer, with their role there where disclosed.

allowed_values: no / not confirmed by grade A/B source / not disclosed / yes
description: Whether a founder move is confirmed by a grade A or B source.
Number or description of staff who moved, as stated.
coding_rule: "not disclosed" = no eligible source states the value. It does not mean none.

description: Target headcount before the deal, with its date.
coding_rule: "not disclosed" = no eligible source states the value. It does not mean none.

allowed_values: bankruptcy / continued / not disclosed / pivoted / product discontinued / sold / sold assets / sold later / wound down
description: Status of the target company after the deal.
coding_rule: From the latest dated source (status_date).

description: Date of the target_status_after observation.
Short note on target_status_after.
What the target’s investors received, as stated.
What happened to staff who did not move, as stated.
Target’s last valuation before the deal, as stated.
coding_rule: "not disclosed" = no eligible source states the value. It does not mean none.

description: Date of that valuation.

allowed_values: cleared / formal review / inquiry opened / letters from US senators / none known / not disclosed
description: Highest level of regulator attention known.
coding_rule: Ordered: none known < letters from US senators < inquiry opened < formal review < cleared or closed. "not disclosed" = no eligible source states the value. It does not mean none.

description: Short neutral description of regulator actions.
Where sources disagree on a value: what each says. "none" = no disagreement recorded.
coding_rule: Both values are shown as reported; neither is averaged or chosen unless a filing settles it.

description: What announce_date is based on (company announcement, filing, or first public report).
Other relevant facts from the sources.
How complete the record is: full, core (key fields only) or partial.

allowed_values: AI lab / large listed buyer / mega-cap over $100bn / not disclosed / other buyer / other listed
description: Size class of the buyer.
coding_rule: "mega-cap over $100bn" = market capitalisation above USD 100bn at announcement. "large listed buyer" and "other buyer" are coarser classes used where market capitalisation was not checked.

allowed_values: bankruptcy / company wound down / continued / not disclosed / pivoted / sold
description: Status of the remaining company at the latest record.
Date of remainder_after.
Later valuation of the remaining company, as stated.
coding_rule: "not disclosed" = no eligible source states the value. It does not mean none.

description: Whether founders were still at the buyer at the latest record.
Links several deals (tranches) between the same buyer and target.
Number of tranches in the relationship.
disclosed_value_usd divided by hsr_threshold_usd, where both exist.
coding_rule: n/a where either is missing. Not a finding that a filing was required.

description: Tier of the record: core, extended (shown as "related" on the website) or hold.
coding_rule: core = the buyer gained at least one control lever (staff, a licence, a board seat or a veto). extended = investment with a commercial tie, compute-for-equity, or AI infrastructure. hold = evidence incomplete; excluded from counts on the website.

allowed_values: AI infrastructure & chips / applied AI & agents / data & autonomous systems / foundation models / not disclosed
description: AI stack layer of the target.
coding_rule: Assigned from target_focus: foundation models; applied AI & agents; AI infrastructure & chips; data & autonomous systems.

description: Reason the companies gave for the deal, quoted or closely paraphrased.
Jurisdiction used to compare the deal with merger-filing thresholds.
coding_rule: Target-country proxy. This is not a finding that a filing was required.

description: Year whose threshold applies.
Stage of the transaction at the latest source (for example announced, agreed, completed, proposed employment offers).
coding_rule: Coded from the most authoritative source; a European Commission DMA Article 14 notice is coded at the agreed stage unless it describes completed hiring.

description: Employment offers reported, where completed hires are not confirmed.
Short description of how the deal is structured, from the sources.
Whether the buyer holds a voting board seat.
coding_rule: "no (stated)" = a source says there is none. "not disclosed" = no eligible source states the value. It does not mean none.

description: Whether the buyer holds an observer or advisory committee seat.
Buyer veto or consent rights.
Commercial exclusivity tied to the deal (for example sole cloud provider).

allowed_values: no / not applicable / not disclosed / yes
description: Right of first refusal held by the buyer.
Buyer rights to consult or advise management.
Whether exclusivity (or non-exclusivity) is stated in an official (grade A) source.
coding_rule: "no (stated)" = an official source says the licence is non-exclusive.

description: Target’s commitment to spend on the buyer’s cloud or compute, as stated.
Date of that valuation.
Target’s total funding before the deal, as stated.
coding_rule: "not disclosed" = no eligible source states the value. It does not mean none.

description: Lead investors in the target’s funding rounds, as stated.
How the money was paid out (to investors, employees or the company), as stated.
Dated observation of the remaining company about 6 months after announcement.
coding_rule: The dated public observation closest to the anniversary; remainder_6m_observed_date gives its date.

description: Date of the 6-month observation.
Dated observation about 12 months after announcement.
coding_rule: As for remainder_6m.

description: Date of the 12-month observation.
Dated observation about 24 months after announcement.
coding_rule: As for remainder_6m.

description: Date of the 24-month observation.
How threshold_jurisdiction was chosen.
Why the record sits in its tier, in one or two sentences.
Evidence class for the five key facts (acquirer, target, announce_date, deal_type, structure_facts).
coding_rule: primary = at least one grade A source; two_source = two independent grade B newsrooms; first_report = date from a single dated report (allowed for dates); single = one grade B report only; none = no tagged source. Counts only quotes confirmed word for word.

description: The tier rule the record meets.
Short notes on the scope of individual coded fields, keyed by field name.
Number of sources for the deal.
Number of grade A sources for the deal.
Coded fields of this deal whose only support is one grade B report (no grade A source and no second independent newsroom).
coding_rule: Use this to exclude single-report facts from an analysis.

description: The same disagreements in structured form: field, each version with its value and source.
Jurisdiction of incorporation, where a source states it and it differs from target_country.
Additional dated observations of a field (value, type, date and source) kept alongside the coded value.
Advisers named in public sources: firm, role, side and source URL.
Summary of the evidence where it is limited or unusual.
Scope of the amount where it covers more than this deal (tranches, rounds, ceilings).

allowed_values: Single dated report: the article proves its own publication date (first public report).
description: Set where the date rests on a single dated report.
coding_rule: A dated news report can establish its own publication date, so a first public report may date a deal on its own.

description: US HSR size-of-transaction threshold for threshold_year.
Date of the European Commission DMA Article 14 notification, where one exists.
Buyer and target rationale separately, each with its quote and source URL.
Target’s legal name where it differs from target.
Buyer’s legal or group name where it differs from acquirer.
Wind-down announcement, where the target announced one.
Type of money where the deal’s amount is not broken into components.
Record-level note on how a related or held record is defined.
Sources for the deal (deals.json only; flattened in sources.csv, where each column is described).
Dated actions by competition authorities and other public bodies (deals.json only; flattened in regulatory_events.csv).
Each disclosed amount as stated, with its type (deals.json only; flattened in money_components.csv).
coding_rule: Components are never added together, within a deal or across deals.

description: Deal the source belongs to (see deals.csv).
Source number within the deal.
Who published the page or document.
Title of the page or document, where recorded.
Publication date of the source.
Source grade: A or B.
coding_rule: A = the company, a filing, a regulator, a court or a registry. B = a major newsroom with editorial standards.

description: Address of the source as checked.
Wayback Machine copy of the source. Empty where none exists.
Why a source has no archived copy (for example, the site blocks archiving).
Exact quote from the source supporting the coded facts (at most 20 words).
coding_rule: Copied word for word; spacing, quote marks and dashes may be normalised.

description: Fields (or finer evidence labels such as tier_evidence or reported_amount) that this quote supports, separated by "; ".
Original source this report repeats, where it does.
coding_rule: A report that repeats another is not an independent second newsroom.

description: Note on how the source is used.
Best result across all quote checks.
coding_rule: exact if any check found the quote word for word.

description: Which check established quote_status.
Result of the automated checker (verify_sources.py), which fetches the page or archived copy and looks for the quote.
When the automated check ran.
Result of a check on the page as rendered in a browser, used where the page needs JavaScript (for example the EU DMA register).
Who or what made the separate second check of the quote.
When the second check was made.
Research round in which the source was added (blank = before round 6).
Deal the event belongs to.
Date of the action.
Authority or public body.
What the body did.
Source for the event.
Case or document reference, where one exists.
Deal the amount belongs to.
Amount as stated by the source.
coding_rule: Never added to other components.

description: Currency of original_amount ("as stated" where the source mixes currencies).
Type of amount (investment, commitment or ceiling, licence fee, round total and so on).
Whether the amount is one tranche, a cumulative figure or a ceiling, and what it excludes.
Source for the amount.
Exact quote stating the amount.
Buyer in the excluded candidate.
Target in the excluded candidate.
Reason code.
coding_rule: E1 full acquisition; E2 no control rights; E3 not an AI startup; E4 insufficient evidence; E6 other.

allowed_values: Full acquisition / Insufficient evidence / No control rights / Not an AI startup / Other
description: Label for exclusion_code.
Why the candidate was excluded.
Source for the exclusion. Empty for 11 full acquisitions kept only as a comparison set.
Grade of that source.
When the exclusion was checked.
Deal researched.
Field requested in round 6.

allowed_values: conflict / found / not applicable / not disclosed (quoted) / not found
description: Outcome: found, not found, not applicable, conflict, or not disclosed (quoted).
Where the researcher looked.
What was found.
Column or key name.
File the field appears in.
Data type (str, int, float, date, datetime, list, dict; "int|str" = number, or text such as "not disclosed").
Allowed values for enumerated fields, computed from the data.
What the field holds.
How a value is chosen where a judgement is involved. Blank where the description is enough.
